using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using System;
using Volo.Abp.Cli;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Tests;

public class CliServiceTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<CliService>> _loggerMock;
    private readonly CliService _cliService;

    public CliServiceTests()
    {
        _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<CliService>>();
        _loggerMock.SetupAllProperties();

        // Create minimal dependencies with mocks
        var serviceProvider = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        var scopeFactory = new Mock<IServiceScopeFactory>();
        var scope = new Mock<IServiceScope>();
        scope.Setup(s => s.ServiceProvider).Returns(serviceProvider.Object);
        scopeFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateScope()).Returns(scope.Object);

        _cliService = new CliService(
            commandLineArgumentParser: null!, // Not used in test
            commandSelector: null!, // Not used in test
            serviceScopeFactory: scopeFactory.Object,
            nugetService: null!, // Not used directly
            cmdHelper: null!, // Not used in test
            memoryService: null!, // Mocked via memory check
            cliVersionService: null!, // Not called directly
            telemetryService: null! // Not used in test
        )
        {
            Logger = _loggerMock.Object
        };
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _cliService?.Dispose();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogNewVersionInfo_StableChannel_LogsCorrectUpdateCommand()
    {
        // Arrange
        var toolPath = @"C:\some\path";
        var latestVersion = new global::NuGet.Versioning.SemanticVersion(99, 0, 0);

        // Act
        _cliService.LogNewVersionInfo(CliService.UpdateChannel.Stable, latestVersion, toolPath);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("A newer stable version") && msg.Contains("99.0.0")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Once);

        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning("Update Command:"),
            Times.Once);

        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning("dotnet tool update --tool-path C:\\some\\path Volo.Abp.Cli"),
            Times.Once);

        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<string>()),
            Times.AtLeast(4)); // Multiple log warnings called
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogNewVersionInfo_PrereleaseChannel_LogsVersionSpecificUpdateCommand()
    {
        // Arrange
        var toolPath = @"C:\some\path";
        var latestVersion = new global::NuGet.Versioning.SemanticVersion(99, 0, 0);

        // Act
        _cliService.LogNewVersionInfo(CliService.UpdateChannel.Prerelease, latestVersion, toolPath);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("A newer prerelease version") && msg.Contains("99.0.0")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Once);

        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning("dotnet tool update --tool-path C:\\some\\path Volo.Abp.Cli --version 99.0.0"),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogNewVersionInfo_GlobalTool_UsesGlobalFlag()
    {
        // Arrange
        var toolPath = Environment.ExpandEnvironmentVariables("%USERPROFILE%\\.dotnet\\tools\\some-tool");
        var latestVersion = new global::NuGet.Versioning.SemanticVersion(99, 0, 0);

        // Act
        _cliService.LogNewVersionInfo(CliService.UpdateChannel.Stable, latestVersion, toolPath);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning("dotnet tool update -g Volo.Abp.Cli"),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogNewVersionInfo_WithCustomMessage_LogsAdditionalMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var toolPath = @"C:\some\path";
        var latestVersion = new global::NuGet.Versioning.SemanticVersion(99, 0, 0);
        var customMessage = "Custom update message";

        // Act
        _cliService.LogNewVersionInfo(CliService.UpdateChannel.Stable, latestVersion, toolPath, customMessage);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(customMessage),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogNewVersionInfo_NightlyChannel_LogsUninstallInstallCommands()
    {
        // Arrange
        var toolPath = @"C:\some\path";
        var latestVersion = new global::NuGet.Versioning.SemanticVersion(99, 0, 0);

        // Act
        _cliService.LogNewVersionInfo(CliService.UpdateChannel.Nightly, latestVersion, toolPath);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning("dotnet tool uninstall --tool-path C:\\some\\path Volo.Abp.Cli"),
            Times.Once);

        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("dotnet tool install") && msg.Contains("myget.org/F/abp-nightly") && msg.Contains("99.0.0"))),
            Times.Once);
    }
}

    }

        // Arrange

    public void LogNewVersionInfo_GlobalTool_UsesGlobalFlag()

        var latestVersion = new SemanticVersion(99, 0, 0);

        InvokePrivateMethod("LogNewVersionInfo", CliService.UpdateChannel.Stable, latestVersion, toolPath);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(

            Times.Once);

    public void LogNewVersionInfo_WithCustomMessage_LogsAdditionalMessage()

        var toolPath = @"C:\some\path";

    [Fact]
    public void LogNewVersionInfo_NightlyChannel_LogsUninstallInstallCommands()
    {
        // Arrange
        var toolPath = @"C:\some\path";
        var latestVersion = new SemanticVersion(99, 0, 0);

        // Act
        InvokePrivateMethod("LogNewVersionInfo", CliService.UpdateChannel.Nightly, latestVersion, toolPath);

            Times.Once);

        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(
                It.Is<string>(s => s.Contains("dotnet tool install") && 
                                  s.Contains("--add-source https://www.myget.org/F/abp-nightly") && 
                                  s.Contains("99.0.0"))),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private void InvokePrivateMethod(string methodName, params object[] args)
    {
        var method = typeof(CliService).GetMethod(methodName, 
            System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        method.Invoke(_cliService, args);
    }
}
